entries.note: Round 1. Independent audit of all 37 keys against en/wire.voice.json + wire.voice.context.json, i18n/glossary.md, the locale style guide and neighbouring wire.settings.speech / wire.voice_availability. Scripted over all 37 keys: key set equals en; {placeholders} identical to en ({session_id},{reason},{limit_mib},{detail}); no ICU plural/select arms in this namespace; identifiers text_origin/qwen_s2s, WAV/WebM/Ogg/MP4, UUID, MiB, Radient and ElevenLabs preserved; no bidi/zero-width controls, no ASCII quotes, no markdown/digit/symbol in the 6 spoken wire.voice.phrase.* strings; max_spoken_chars.help quotes phrase.truncated exactly. target_sha256 is the file audited (post-fix for fr/ru). Glossary/neighbour consistency: conversation, agent, approvals, provider, key and 'try again in a moment' match the shipped corpus of the locale. Back-translations of the 10 most consequential strings (approval/refusal/limit/provider), all faithful: approval_pending: First answer the question or approval present on screen.; phrase.on_screen_first: First answer the approval present on screen.; not_enabled: Voice mode is not on for this conversation. First turn it on for this conversation.; rate_limited_minute: The speech provider's per-minute limit has been reached. Try again after a little while.; rate_limited_day: The speech provider's daily limit has finished. Try again after it resets.; upload_too_large: That recording is too big. Keep it below {limit_mib} MiB.; provider.help: Who hears you and speaks on your behalf, for hands-free voice and the read-aloud button. Radient's bill is made from your Radient credit; ElevenLabs uses your own key. Only the one you choose is used, and if it can't fulfil a request it states the reason instead of going to the other.; provider.choice.none.description: No provider chosen yet. Until you choose one, hands-free voice stays off.; provider.choice.elevenlabs.description: Your own ElevenLabs API key. ElevenLabs sends the bill to you directly.; provider_unset: First choose a speech provider: Radient or your own ElevenLabs key. Voice mode uses only the one you choose..  no findings. Not verified: the English 'Speak button' is a UI label; the locale renders it descriptively as a read-aloud button and the client's real label was not checked here. No rendered, native-speaker, or RTL rendering claim (ur: strings only; bidi handled by the render layer per the style guide). Same model family as the translator, different session and brief.
